errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert, außer nach Einkommenskategorien.
errors.evidence: This statement is confusing. While it is true that the bars are not sorted by their value (e.g., descending), they are clearly ordered according to the sequential income categories on the x-axis. The phrasing "nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert" (not sorted in a specific order) is potentially misleading, as there is a clear and logical order present. A more accurate description would be that the bars are ordered by the ascending income categories.
